evidence.locator: the display file occupies locations 16384 to 22527
evidence.claim: The display file is the pixel layer at $4000-$57FF, addressed directly by this program.
The attribute area is 768 bytes at $5800, one byte per character cell.
The border colour is set by writing port 254, which is what this program's OUT to $FE does.

evidence.locator: 256 less than address of character set
evidence.claim: The ROM character set is reached through CHARS, which holds an address 256 below it — the basis of the $3C00 font addressing here.

firmware.guidance: Supply a legally obtained ZX Spectrum 48K ROM at the path above. The ROM is never copied into the report.
firmware.note: emu198x-spectrum has no --rom flag and resolves the ROM from this path itself, so the proof verifies the ROM the emulator will load rather than passing one. See emu198x/emu198x#842.
